audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart reads Talon/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Skill/Talon/Talon/Talon/Talon/Ekko/Ekko. Every row renders two answers.
audit.why: Level 1 is even; from 2 Talon's Rake into Noxian Diplomacy stacks Blade's End to three and the bleed wins any trade, and that holds through 6 when Shadow Assault adds a stealth entry. Ekko's first item and Chronobreak flip it after. 46.94% over 1881 games matches a Talon-favoured lane that Ekko wins later.
audit.corrected: Full phases[0..6].side set to Skill/Talon/Talon/Talon/Talon/Ekko/Ekko with ratings and whys rewritten in the same group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose carried no cooldowns and the level-6 row was placed as Ekko's when it is Talon's.
audit.why: Shadow Assault is 100/80/60 and Chronobreak is 110/80/50 — at rank 1 his ultimate comes back FIRST, which is why 6 does not flip the lane. That number was absent.
audit.corrected: Stated the 100s vs 110s comparison in dosFull[1].d and moved the level-6 row to Talon.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Talon ability was named anywhere (packet defect), and the mobility interaction flagged in missingInteractions was absent: Assassin's Path vaults terrain Ekko's 325-range E cannot follow.
audit.why: Riot's text: Assassin's Path 'has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown'. That is the actual counterplay — a wall he has already vaulted is locked out, so the punish window is defined by which walls he has spent, not by a spell timer. Also Blade's End: his spells stack Wound three times and the third auto applies a heavy bleed, so Rake's two passes plus a Q leap complete the stack by themselves.
audit.corrected: Named Blade's End, Noxian Diplomacy, Rake, Assassin's Path and Shadow Assault; stated the spent-wall window in cooldowns and carry, and the three-stack bleed in enemyWin and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Rake 9s->7s, Noxian Diplomacy 8s from 575 range, and the terrain lockout on Assassin's Path.

audit.whatIsWrong: COPY_PASTE_BLEED on dosFull[1].d (tradeGood verbatim) and dontsFull[2].d (tradeBad verbatim).
audit.why: Bodies did not match their titles.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten from Talon's kit against their own titles.
